controles.affirmation: Le ministere americain de la Justice a ouvert une enquete civile ET penale sur Accenture Federal Services apres une declaration volontaire, avec risque d'exclusion des marches publics federaux
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q du 18/06/2026 : After Accenture Federal Services (AFS) made a voluntary disclosure to the U.S. government, the U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) initiated a civil and criminal investigation concerning whether one or more employees provided inaccurate submissions to an assessor ... This matter could subject us to adverse consequences, including civil and criminal penalties, including under the civil U.S. False Claims Act ... and administrative sanctions, such as termination of contracts, forfeiture of profits, suspension of payments, fines and suspensions or debarment from doing business with agencies of the U.S. government. We cannot at this time determine when or how this matter will be resolved or estimate the cost or range of costs in excess of the amounts already accrued.

controles.affirmation: La progression mise en avant sur l'exercice 2026 (+20 points de base) est une progression AJUSTEE, la marge publiee recule (15,4% contre 15,7% sur neuf mois)

controles.correction_proposee: Le recul de 15,7% a 15,4% sur neuf mois est exact, mais la societe guide egalement une marge PUBLIEE (GAAP) de 15,3% sur l'exercice 2026, soit +60 points de base sur FY25 : ce n'est donc pas seulement la marge ajustee qui progresse. Ajouter cette guidance GAAP, sinon la phrase laisse croire que toute progression de marge disparait hors retraitement.
